name: parrot
description: Session-bound listening and recaps with your agent's context. Typed requests delegate work; spoken requests wait for post-meeting approval.

interface.shortDescription: Listen to sessions and recap transcripts
interface.longDescription: Use the installed Parrot Scribe app for session-bound listening and recaps. Requires Parrot Scribe 1.0.1 or later with Pro, MCP enabled, and a separate client token supplied to Codex's environment.
defaultPrompt: Recap my latest completed Parrot Scribe session.
